notes:
POC summary:
- Retail catalog: 52M SKUs (variants + locale), ~2TB raw product metadata + images. Goal: semantic catalog search + on-the-fly reranking to boost CTR on PLP by 12–18%.
- Current stack: Elastic cluster for text search, in-house heuristic reranker. Considering replacing vector index + reranker with Redwood-managed inference to reduce infra ops.
Key requirements:
- Indexing scale: want an embedding store capable of 50M+ vectors with sharded/partitioned hot sets for seasonal spikes.
- Latency targets: p95 < 80ms for search + rerank combined in NA; p99 SLO target 250ms during spikes.
- Throughput: baseline 300 qps; expected peaks up to 4,500 qps during promotions (Black Friday-level).
- Cost sensitivity: target blended cost-per-query (embedding lookup + model rerank) <= $0.005; ideally <= $0.002 for scale.
- Model preferences: open LLMs (quantized) for rerank; prefer ability to route to cheaper variants for low-risk queries.
- Caching/Batching: request automatic prefix / KV caching for session-based queries; aggressive batching during peak windows.
- Compliance: SSO + audit logs required; prefer VPC/private control plane for sensitive pricing attributes.
